title: The Jackiw-Rebbi model. Bose/Fermi one-loop Kink mass shifts
summary: Scalar and spinor Kink fluctuations are summarized in the Jackiw-Rebbi model. Canonical quantization is conventionally achieved by promoting the coefficients of the scalar and spinor field expansions to bosonic/fermionic creation/annihilation operators. One-particle states for bosons, respectively for fermions, are supplied by the scalar eigenfunctions of the Schr$\ddot{\rm o}$dinger, respectively, the eigenspinors of the Dirac Hamiltonian, evaluated either on the ground state or the Kink background.
